instruction: A candid outdoor photograph with a full shot of a lakeside park in autumn, ground covered in fallen leaves. On the right, the man in the brown cardigan (R1) leans against a tree trunk, looking down and smiling. On the left, the red-haired woman in the white turtleneck (R2) stands facing him, holding yellow leaves. They are positioned close together, jointly holding and looking at the yellow autumn leaves. The background features a soft-focus lake. The scene is illuminated by soft natural daylight, highlighting a warm autumn palette of browns, whites, and yellows.
